title: Council facilities and road tour
subtitle: Craighead House ribbon cutting, Operations Centre, Sportsplex and Bissell Park visits; no major policy decisions.
overview: Centre Wellington Council held a special meeting on May 21, 2026 that was mostly a tour of township facilities and roads. Council relaxed its procedural rules for the duration of the tour {{vote:m1}}, so members could move between sites and talk more freely.

The tour left from 1 MacDonald Square in Elora at 9:30 a.m. The first stop was Craighead House at 495 Union St W in Fergus, where a ribbon-cutting ceremony took place. Council then visited the Centre Wellington Operations Centre on Gartshore St, the Centre Wellington Sportsplex on Belsyde Ave, and Bissell Park on Melville St in Elora. Deputy Mayor Jefferson chaired part of the tour while Mayor Watters was away from the Chair, and the Mayor resumed the Chair at 11:55 a.m.

No spending, planning or policy decisions were made. Council passed the routine confirming by-law {{vote:m2}} and adjourned {{vote:m3}}. For residents, the meeting was an opportunity for council to see township facilities and parks first-hand.

decisions.item: Relaxing the rules for the tour
decisions.detail: Council relaxed its rules of procedure for the duration of the facilities and road tour {{vote:m1}}.
